newsitem.title: GERMANY: German railway raises prices in east and west.
newsitem.headline: German railway raises prices in east and west.

text.p: German railway Deutsche Bahn AG said on Thursday it would raise ticket prices for local and long distance routes an average of 1.4 percent as of April 1.
From that point on Deutsche Bahn would charge the same prices for almost all riders in western and eastern Germany. The company has given rebates of about 10 percent in the former East Germany.
Prices for student tickets in the east will remain under the western German level until the year 2000, Deutsche Bahn said.
Price changes for local routes are subject to approval by German state governments.
